nodes.label: Two Backends In One App
nodes.rationale: /api/v1/** (legacy casting: applications, files, news, login) runs on production uzcasting.site; /api/v1/app/** (new platform: home, content, entitlement, media) exists only locally because production still runs the old build.

nodes.label: HomeFeedUnavailableError
nodes.rationale: Production answers GET /api/v1/app/home with 200 but returns the site's index.html because the SPA intercepts unknown paths. Axios does not treat that as an error, so the client must validate the response shape itself.

nodes.label: Phone OTP Login Flow
nodes.rationale: Login and registration are one flow: otp/verify finds the phone's owner or creates a ROLE_USER, exactly as auth/google does. 4-digit code, 3-minute lifetime, BCrypt-hashed in server memory, 2-minute resend cooldown (429 OTP_COOLDOWN), 5 wrong attempts lock the code (429 OTP_LOCKED). Phone is normalised to 998XXXXXXXXX so input format does not matter.

nodes.label: OTP Error Code Translation
nodes.rationale: Backend ApiError{code,message} text is Uzbek-only (TZ §94), so the app translates by code in src/features/auth/otpErrors.ts: OTP_COOLDOWN, OTP_INVALID, OTP_EXPIRED, OTP_LOCKED, SMS_NOT_CONFIGURED, SMS_SEND_FAILED.

nodes.label: Eskiz SMS Gateway
nodes.rationale: Without ESKIZ_EMAIL/ESKIZ_PASSWORD sending fails with 503 SMS_NOT_CONFIGURED on purpose — a silent 'success' with no SMS would be worse, mirroring the Google-without-keys behaviour. The app.otp.message-template text must match the template approved in the Eskiz cabinet or the gateway rejects the send.

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/casting-user/web Catalog
nodes.rationale: Live endpoint returning real casting profiles (~68 KB). Client rules mirrored from the site: show only photos with isWebShow true and drop profiles with none, compute age from birthday when absent, lowercase castingType.

nodes.label: Public PII Exposure Finding
nodes.rationale: The unauthenticated catalog returns phone, email, telegram, instagram, exact birthdate and body measurements including for minors (an age:17 record). The mobile Creator type deliberately omits them, but the fix belongs on the backend: serve only showcase fields publicly and move contacts behind an authenticated request, which also cuts the 68 KB payload.

nodes.label: SecurityConfig permitAll On Everything
nodes.rationale: Root cause of the PII leak: SecurityConfig permits GET/POST/PUT/DELETE on /** without a token, so the JWT filter — written and working — has nothing left to enforce, including on admin and write endpoints. Fix is to narrow permitAll to genuinely public routes and mark the rest .authenticated() with role checks.

nodes.label: castingType vs TZ Categories Mismatch
nodes.rationale: Only 4 of the 10 TZ directions exist in the database (actor, model, bloger, influencer); six are missing and two DB types (euromodel, extra) are absent from the TZ. Recorded in src/features/catalog/categories.ts as apiType, where null means 'no such type in the DB yet'.

nodes.label: Home Feed Response Shape
nodes.rationale: One response carries the whole home screen; exactly one of banners/content/categories/creators is filled per section type. Card fields in src/features/home/types.ts mirror HomeFeedDto.java. Empty sections are omitted. Cards carry accessPolicy but no price, so posters show a policy badge rather than an amount.

nodes.label: Lazily Created Homepage Sections
nodes.rationale: Home rows are created lazily on the first admin call to GET /api/v1/app/admin/homepage/sections, so on a clean database /api/v1/app/home honestly returns sections: [] and the app shows an empty state. Verified locally: 0 sections before the admin call, 12 after.

nodes.label: Media Namespace Separation
nodes.rationale: /api/v1/app/media/{id}/raw serves MediaAsset by numeric id, while /api/v1/file/getFile/{uuid} serves legacy casting attachments by UUID — a feed id used against the old endpoint returns 404. Images are open and cached; video checks entitlement and answers 404 (not 403) so existence stays hidden; Range is supported.

nodes.label: Watch Endpoint Client Contract
nodes.rationale: /watch/content/{id} returns 422 VALIDATION_ERROR for multi-episode content — the correct answer, not a failure — and the app uses that to switch to the episode list, because contentType and structureType are different axes (TZ §13/§14) and the feed card carries no structureType. sources[].url points at media/raw which re-checks rights, so the player is given an Authorization header via authHeaders() in src/lib/api.ts.

nodes.label: GET /app/content/{id}/episodes
nodes.rationale: Added in this work; without it series, mini-series and podcasts could not open at all. seasons is filled only for SEASONAL (no invented 'season 0' for EPISODIC), the server fixes the order, unpublished episodes are omitted and unpublished content returns 404 since 'exists but closed' would itself reveal existence. Deliberately contains no video URLs — otherwise the list alone would be enough to take a paid episode. Prices come from here, not from the feed.

nodes.label: Missing Mobile Endpoints
nodes.rationale: No catalog/search, content page, purchases or payments (Click/Payme/Uzum/UZCARD/Visa/MC), casting announcements (absent from both old and new API), chats, balance/payout history, Creator Studio 50/50, in-app Premium, or push. src/lib/placeholder.ts survives only for casting announcements and client prices; premieres were removed once the home feed went live.
